title: Berkeley Housing Pipeline Database
description: Track 115 housing development projects in Berkeley, CA from permit filing through Certificate of Occupancy.
source: City of Berkeley Planning & Building Departments

projects.title: All Projects (115)
projects.description: Housing projects with timeline dates - 5,470 total units

project_permits.title: Permits (47)
project_permits.description: Individual permits linked to projects with filing dates

permit_events.title: Permit Events (58)
permit_events.description: Processing status events with dates - track each step of the pipeline

project_velocity.title: Project Velocity (Analysis View)
project_velocity.description: Calculate days at each stage, correction rounds, approval times

stalled_projects.title: Stalled Projects
stalled_projects.description: Projects with no activity for 180+ days
stalled_projects.sql: SELECT address_display, net_units, first_filed_date, last_status_date, CAST(JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(COALESCE(last_status_date, first_filed_date)) AS INTEGER) as days_inactive FROM projects WHERE is_completed = 0 AND JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(COALESCE(last_status_date, first_filed_date)) > 180 ORDER BY days_inactive DESC

timeline_by_project.title: Project Timeline Events
timeline_by_project.description: All events for a specific project
timeline_by_project.sql: SELECT p.address_display, pe.permit_number, pe.stage, pe.action, pe.event_date, pe.marked_by FROM permit_events pe JOIN projects p ON pe.project_id = p.id ORDER BY p.address_display, pe.event_date

fees_by_project.title: Fees by Project
fees_by_project.sql: SELECT p.address_display, p.net_units, p.total_fees_paid, COUNT(pf.id) as fee_payments FROM projects p LEFT JOIN permit_fees pf ON p.id = pf.project_id WHERE p.total_fees_paid > 0 GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.total_fees_paid DESC

permits_by_year.title: Permits Filed by Year
permits_by_year.description: Count of permits filed each year
permits_by_year.sql: SELECT permit_year, permit_prefix, COUNT(*) as count FROM project_permits WHERE permit_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY permit_year, permit_prefix ORDER BY permit_year DESC, count DESC
